news.title: Broccoli Raises $52M to Expand AI Platform for Home Services Businesses
Broccoli Raises $52M Led by Khosla Ventures to Help Home Services Businesses Book More Jobs and Keep Customers Coming Back
Broccoli raises $52M to automate calls and bookings for home-services firms

bullets: Full ownership of a product area, from initial concept through launch, including the roadmap for the foundational capabilities that fuel our next generation of AI agents.
Partner directly with customers to identify new opportunities for AI to reshape their workflows, enable automation, and improve their overall experience.
Build tools that give contractors real control over how their AI agents handle calls, bookings, and follow-ups, tailored to their specific trade, service area, and way of doing…
Turn promising ideas into well-defined product specs, then collaborate with engineering and design to bring them to life, from launch through iteration.
Prioritization manage tradeoffs across new products, feature requests, enterprise vs. SMB needs, and expanding verticals; give the team a clear, defensible view of what's most…
Founder leverage bring enough structure and insight to strategic conversations that the founders can make faster, better decisions on the hard calls
Specs and mockups write specs built around the "why" and produce basic mockups that give engineering enough to move fast
Launch and go-to-market coordinate with customer success, sales, and marketing when features ship; ensuring the right enablement, release notes, and customer comms are in place
Metrics define what success looks like for every feature, ensure the right things get tracked, and review outcomes after every launch
